remaining_doubts: Weights are written with ft² / m² (superscript as shown in the image); the PDF text layer reads 'ft2' / 'm2'. Other chunks use both styles.

Standard Machining Services tables (Cut-to-Size 11-25, Drill Thru 11-46) on pages 5-10 to 5-14 have no service numbers and no 15 badge, so they are kept in notes rather than as machining_service parts.

The -S / -T suffix meaning for 2613, 2614 and 2661 is not stated on these pages (likely smooth/textured, not confirmed); the pages refer to page 5-9 for ordering information, but page 5-9 in this catalog is the Bi-Fold Door Configure page.
Series badge on all panel tables is F + M; recorded as series ['F'] only, per the rule that metric is never listed.
